meta.policy: MLS-to-MLS consideration is excluded from transferFee. Existing salary data carries over unless the workbook supplies an estimated salary; workbook estimates set both baseSalary and guaranteedComp and are marked salaryEstimated=true.

contractMetadata.derivation: Counted inclusively from 2026 through the first calendar year in Contract Thru; PT-prefixed terms are not treated as guaranteed years.

estimatedSalary.rule: Salary estimates set both baseSalary and guaranteedComp and are marked salaryEstimated=true.
